emails.body:
Hello Katie Simpson,

Thank you for shopping with us.
This is a confirmation that your order has been placed and is on its way.
Your order number is #1785.

It contains the following items.
- 2 quantity of Kala KA-15S Mahogany Soprano Ukulele
- 2 quantity of Rachael Ray Yum-o! Nonstick Baking Sheet
- 1 quantity of DEWALT 22 oz. Milled Face Framing Hammer

You can find the receipt attached to this email.

Best,
Amazon Team
